name: nginx-multisite
description: Provisions Nginx as a reverse proxy for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, managing package installation, global and per-site configuration via ERB templates, self-signed TLS certificate generation, and security hardening (fail2ban, UFW firewall, sysctl tuning, SSH hardening).

name: cache
description: Installs and configures a dual caching layer with both Memcached and Redis on the same host, including Redis password authentication and a post-install config-file workaround to remove deprecated Redis directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a full-stack FastAPI Python application by cloning from GitHub, creating a virtual environment, configuring a PostgreSQL database with a dedicated user, writing a .env credentials file, and registering a systemd service running uvicorn on port 8000.
